description: List all usage records, optionally filtered by subscription item. Results are paginated — check meta.page in the response for currentPage, lastPage, and total. Cross-store note: when LEMONSQUEEZY_ALLOWED_STORE_IDS is set, this tool requires at least one of: subscriptionItemId. Even with that set, Pair with a scoped LemonSqueezy API key for true cross-store enforcement -- the API key's visibility is the true boundary.
name: ls_list_usage_records
